unit.label: Describe, compare & choose
unit.title: Choosing a Phone
unit.description: 13 new words and forms. Talk about phones, new and old items, price, the kind you want, and what a device can do.

goal.pinyin: Zhè zhī shǒujī néng shàngwǎng ma?

unit.bookReference: A Course in Contemporary Chinese 1 · Lesson 4 請問一共多少錢？ · pp. 68–76, 79.

lessons.title: A Phone, Two Phones
lessons.subtitle: Use the right measure for the device.

steps.prompt: Which means this phone?
steps.explanation: Use the phone measure 支.
手 is shǒu: hand (in 手機, phone).

steps.prompt: Review: 一萬三千塊 is how much?
Which uses the plain 很 + adjective pattern taught here?
steps.explanation: Use 很 before the adjective without 是.
舊 is jiù: old; not new.

steps.prompt: Review: which means “I would like to buy”?
steps.explanation: 想買 is want to buy; 賣 is sell.

lessons.title: Expensive or Inexpensive?
lessons.subtitle: Give an opinion about a price.

steps.prompt: What does 不便宜 mean?
steps.explanation: 不 negates 便宜, inexpensive. It does not negate 貴.

steps.prompt: Which pronunciation is used for 便宜 here?
steps.explanation: Here 便 is pián and 宜 is yí.

steps.prompt: Ask whether the price is high.
steps.explanation: A-not-A already makes a question; omit 嗎.

steps.prompt: Review: which phrase asks someone to buy tea for her?
steps.explanation: 幫她 means for her; 買 is buy.

lessons.title: Which Kind? Which One?
lessons.subtitle: Avoid repeating an item everyone knows.

steps.prompt: Two individual phones of the same model are counted with…
steps.explanation: 支 counts the devices. 種 would count types.

steps.prompt: Which is the reading of 種 when it means kind or type?
steps.explanation: Use third-tone zhǒng for kind or type.

steps.prompt: While discussing phones, what can 新的 mean?
options: The new phone, with 手機 understood
A new person regardless of context
steps.answer: The new phone, with 手機 understood
steps.explanation: 的 lets the description replace an understood noun.

steps.prompt: Review: which word joins alternatives in a question?
steps.explanation: 還是 presents a choice; 和 joins nouns.

lessons.title: Too Much—and Why
lessons.subtitle: Explain your reaction to a phone.

steps.prompt: In 太貴了, what does 了 do here?
options: Turns it into a yes/no question
steps.explanation: This lesson’s 太…了 pattern expresses a judgment, not past tense.

steps.prompt: Which answers why you do not buy a phone because it is too big?
steps.explanation: Too big is the reason for rejecting it.

steps.prompt: Which is the reading of 為 in 為什麼?
steps.explanation: 為什麼 is wèishénme, with fourth-tone wèi.

steps.prompt: Review: identify an old phone.
steps.explanation: 舊 is old or not new for an object.

lessons.title: What Can It Do?
lessons.subtitle: Ask about photos and internet access.

steps.prompt: Which correctly says “cannot go online”?
steps.explanation: Put 不 before 能 for inability.

steps.prompt: Ask whether the phone can take photos, using A-not-A.
options: 這支手機能不能照相嗎？
steps.explanation: 能不能 already forms a question; do not add 嗎.

steps.prompt: Which new word uses two characters taught in earlier units?
steps.explanation: 上 was in 早上/晚上 and 網 in 打網球; the word 上網 is new.

steps.prompt: Review: what does 也 add in 也能上網?
steps.explanation: 也 adds another capability here.

lessons.title: Choose Your Phone
lessons.subtitle: Understand price, condition, reasons and functions.

steps.prompt: Ask for the price of this phone.
steps.explanation: 支 counts the phone; 多少錢 asks its price.

steps.prompt: A phone costs 一萬三千塊. How much?
steps.explanation: One ten-thousand plus three thousands.

steps.prompt: Two types of phones are…
steps.explanation: 種 counts types; 支 counts individual devices.

steps.prompt: What does 你為什麼不買那支手機 ask?
options: Why you are not buying that phone
steps.answer: Why you are not buying that phone
steps.explanation: 為什麼 asks a reason.

steps.prompt: The seller says 這支手機不能照相. What limitation is stated?
steps.explanation: 不能照相 specifically means unable to take photos.

steps.prompt: Phones are being discussed. 新的還是舊的？ asks…
options: The new one or the old one?
steps.answer: The new one or the old one?
steps.explanation: The noun is understood after description + 的.

steps.prompt: Review: how do you politely ask for help buying tea?
steps.explanation: 幫我買 asks someone to buy it for you.

steps.prompt: A phone can go online, but the buyer rejects its excessive price. Which reason fits?
steps.explanation: The stated reason is price, not internet capability.

newVocabulary.note: Use second tone on both syllables here.

newVocabulary.meaning: to go online; use the internet
newVocabulary.note: Both characters were taught earlier, but 上網 is a new word here.

手.note: 手 is hand. Together with 機 it forms 手機, mobile phone; learn the complete device name.
手.memory: Two horizontal levels and a short top slant are crossed by the long central hook.

parts.label: 手
parts.name: four-stroke hand
parts.description: Write the short top slant, the two horizontal strokes, then the central vertical hook.

機.note: 機 completes 手機. Keep the Traditional 木 + 幾 structure; the small side dots are part of the character.
機.memory: Wood 木 stands to the left of the familiar 幾 shape from 幾個.

parts.label: 木
parts.name: left wood component
parts.description: Keep 木 narrow, with a short final dot to leave room for the right half.

parts.label: 幾
parts.name: right component
parts.description: The twelve-stroke 幾 has two small thread shapes at the top and crossed strokes below.

支.note: Use 支 to count phones: 一支手機, one phone. Use 兩支 for two.
支.memory: A small 十 sits above the spreading 又 shape.

parts.label: 十
parts.name: upper cross
parts.description: Write the horizontal and vertical in the upper part.

parts.label: 又
parts.name: lower component
parts.description: Write the bent left-falling stroke and the long right-falling stroke below.

新.note: 新 describes a new item. Put it before 手機 for a new phone, or use 很新 to describe the phone.
新.memory: A dense 亲 shape sits beside the open strokes of 斤 on the right.

parts.label: 亲
parts.name: left component
parts.description: Write the upper 立-like strokes and the lower wood-like strokes on the left.

parts.label: 斤
parts.name: right component
parts.description: Finish with the two slants, horizontal and vertical of 斤.

舊.note: 舊 means old or not new for an item such as a phone. Do not use it to state a person’s age.
舊.memory: The grass top and 隹 bird shape sit over the mortar-shaped 臼 at the bottom.

parts.label: 艹
parts.name: Taiwan grass top
parts.description: Write the four-stroke grass top with two separated crosses.

parts.label: 隹
parts.name: middle bird component
parts.description: Write the compact 隹 below the grass top, keeping its horizontal lines distinct.

parts.label: 臼
parts.name: lower mortar shape
parts.description: Finish 臼 with inward-facing short lines and a connected lower edge.

貴.note: 貴 describes a high price. 很貴 means expensive; 不貴 means not expensive.
貴.memory: A compact crossed top rests on 貝, the shell component also visible in money-related characters.

parts.label: 𠀐
parts.name: upper structure
parts.description: Write the upper box with its central crossing vertical and the horizontal beneath it.

parts.label: 貝
parts.name: lower shell
parts.description: Write the lower 貝 box, its inner lines and two short spreading strokes.

便.meaning: first syllable of 便宜, inexpensive
便.note: In 便宜, read 便 as pián, second tone. The reading biàn belongs to other words.
便.memory: A narrow person 亻 stands left of the crossed box of 更.

parts.label: 亻
parts.name: person component
parts.description: Write the short slant and vertical on the left.

parts.label: 更
parts.name: right component
parts.description: Write the top horizontal and box-like center of 更, then the long crossing lower strokes.

宜.meaning: final syllable of 便宜, inexpensive
宜.note: Here 便宜 is piányí, with second-tone yí.
宜.memory: A roof 宀 covers the tiered lines of 且.

parts.label: 宀
parts.name: roof component
parts.description: Write the top dot, left roof mark and bent roof stroke.

parts.label: 且
parts.name: lower tiers
parts.description: Write 且 under the roof: the upright frame, internal horizontal lines and long base.

種.note: 種 is zhǒng, third tone, when it means kind or type. 一種手機 is one kind of phone.
種.memory: 禾 stands next to the dense stacked lines of 重.

parts.label: 禾
parts.name: left grain component
parts.description: Write the top slant, horizontal, vertical and two lower marks of 禾.

parts.label: 重
parts.name: right component
parts.description: Write the layered 重 with its central vertical and horizontal base lines.

太.note: 太 before a description means too or overly. In 太貴了 it expresses that the price is too high.
太.memory: 太 is 大 with an extra dot underneath its crossing strokes.

parts.label: 大
parts.name: large spreading strokes
parts.description: Write the horizontal, left-falling and right-falling strokes of 大.

parts.label: 丶
parts.name: lower dot
parts.description: Add the dot below the center; it distinguishes 太 from 大.

了.note: Here 了 ends 太…了 and adds emphasis to the speaker’s reaction. It does not make this sentence past tense.
了.memory: 了 has only a bent top and a curved vertical hook. It has no crossing horizontal like 子.

parts.label: 乛
parts.name: bent top
parts.description: Write the top horizontal with its short downward bend.

parts.label: 亅
parts.name: lower hook
parts.description: Write the longer curved vertical hook below.

為.meaning: first syllable of 為什麼, why
為.note: Use fourth-tone wèi in 為什麼 wèishénme, why. Other uses of 為 can have a different tone.
為.memory: Follow the descending bends in the upper structure, then place four dots along the bottom.

parts.label: 為
parts.name: upper bent structure
parts.description: Write the top dot and slant, followed by the three descending bent strokes.

parts.label: 灬
parts.name: four lower dots
parts.description: Finish with four separate dots along the bottom, from left to right.

能.note: 能 describes capability here: a phone can take pictures or go online. 不能 places 不 before 能.
能.memory: 厶 and a month-like box fill the left; two spoon-like 匕 shapes sit on the right.

parts.label: 厶
parts.name: upper left component
parts.description: Write the bent stroke and small dot at the upper left.

parts.label: 月
parts.name: lower left component
parts.description: Write the narrow box under 厶 and its two inner horizontals.

parts.label: 匕匕
parts.name: two right components
parts.description: Write the upper two-stroke 匕, then repeat the shape below.

u14-phones.title: Count phones with 支
u14-phones.pattern: number + 支 + 手機; 這 / 那 + 支 + 手機
u14-phones.explanation: 手機 shǒujī means mobile phone. Use 支 zhī to count phones here: 一支手機, one phone; 兩支手機, two phones. Put 這 or 那 before 支 to point to a phone: 這支手機, this phone. The noun alone still works when you are not counting or pointing: 我想買手機. Do not replace 支 with 杯, the measure for cups.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ yǒu liǎng zhī shǒujī.
Zhè zhī shǒujī duōshǎo qián?

u14-phones.remember: Count phones with 支 and two phones with 兩支.

u14-new-old.title: Put a description before the item
u14-new-old.pattern: 新 / 舊 + 手機; 手機 + 很 + 新 / 舊
u14-new-old.explanation: 新 xīn is new; 舊 jiù is old or not new for an item. A short adjective can go directly before the noun: 新手機, a new phone; 舊手機, an old phone. To make a sentence describing it, use the familiar 很 + adjective pattern: 這支手機很新. Do not insert 是 into that ordinary adjective statement. 舊 here describes an object, not someone’s age.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng mǎi yì zhī xīn shǒujī.
examples.meaning: I would like to buy a new phone.

examples.pinyin: Nà zhī shǒujī hěn jiù.
Zhè zhī shǒujī bú jiù.

u14-new-old.remember: 新手機 names a new phone; 手機很新 describes the phone.

u14-price-opinion.title: Describe the price
u14-price-opinion.pattern: item + 很 + 貴 / 便宜; item + 不 + 貴
u14-price-opinion.explanation: 貴 guì means expensive; 便宜 piányí means inexpensive. Use two rising tones in piányí. Use 很 to make an ordinary descriptive statement: 這支手機很貴. 不貴 means not expensive, and 不便宜 means not cheap; those are not exactly the same statement. The familiar A-not-A question works: 貴不貴？ asks whether it is expensive. Actual judgments about price depend on the person and situation.

examples.pinyin: Zhè zhī shǒujī hěn guì.
Nà zhī shǒujī hěn piányí.
Zhè zhī shǒujī guì bu guì?

u14-price-opinion.remember: 很貴 = expensive; 不貴 = not expensive. 便宜 is piányí here.

u14-kind.title: Ask about a type
u14-kind.pattern: 哪 / 這 / 那 + 種 + noun
u14-kind.explanation: 種 zhǒng, third tone, counts kinds or types. 一種手機 is one kind of phone; 一支手機 is one individual phone. Use 哪種手機 for which kind of phone. 哪 is the question form already seen in 哪裡; before a measure it asks which. 那種手機 means that kind of phone, so keep third-tone 哪 nǎ distinct from fourth-tone 那 nà.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ xiǎng mǎi nǎ zhǒng shǒujī?
examples.meaning: What kind of phone would you like to buy?

examples.pinyin: Nà zhǒng shǒujī bú guì.
examples.meaning: That kind of phone is not expensive.

u14-kind.remember: 支 counts phones; 種 counts kinds of phones. 哪 asks which; 那 points to that.

u14-de-ones.title: Use 的 when the noun is understood
u14-de-ones.explanation: You already know 的 for possession. It also lets a description stand for an understood noun. When you are discussing phones, 新的 can mean the new one or new ones; 舊的 means the old one or ones. The context supplies the missing noun. In 我想買新的, 新的 is what you want to buy. Do not add 是 after 買. The phrase does not itself specify singular or plural.

examples.pinyin: Shǒujī, wǒ xiǎng mǎi xīn de.
examples.meaning: As for phones, I would like to buy a new one.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ xǐhuān xīn de háishì jiù de?
examples.meaning: Do you like the new one or the old one?

examples.pinyin: Wǒ yào piányí de.

u14-de-ones.remember: Use description + 的 only when the listener can identify the omitted item.

u14-too.title: React with 太…了
u14-too.explanation: 太 tài before an adjective means too or overly. Add neutral-tone 了 le at the end for an emphatic reaction: 太貴了, too expensive. Here 了 expresses your reaction; it does not mean that the event happened in the past. You can reuse familiar descriptions: 太大了, too big; 太熱了, too hot. 太 does not need 很 as well.

examples.pinyin: Zhè zhī shǒujī tài guì le.
Nà zhī shǒujī tài dà le.

u14-too.remember: 太 + description + 了. Here 了 is a reaction ending, not a past-tense marker.

u14-why.title: Ask for a reason
u14-why.explanation: 為什麼 wèishénme asks why. Put it before what you want explained: 你為什麼不買那支手機？ A reason can be a simple sentence you already know: 那支手機太貴了. You do not need a new word for because to answer this way. Do not add 嗎; 為什麼 already asks the question.

examples.text: 你為什麼不買那支手機？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ wèishénme bù mǎi nà zhī shǒujī?
examples.meaning: Why are you not buying that phone?

examples.pinyin: Nà zhī shǒujī tài guì le.

u14-why.remember: Ask 為什麼, then give the reason as a sentence you know.

u14-capability.title: Describe what a device can do
u14-capability.explanation: 能 néng expresses capability. 上網 shàngwǎng means to go online or use the internet; you already know the characters 上 and 網, but this is a new word. A phone can have the capability to 照相, take photos, or 上網. Put 不 before 能 to negate: 不能上網. Ask 能不能…？ or 能…嗎？; do not combine the two question forms. 會 was introduced for learned skills. For the phone functions in this lesson, use 能. These words overlap in other settings, so this is a useful contrast for this context, not a universal rule.

examples.pinyin: Zhè zhī shǒujī néng shàngwǎng.
Nà zhī shǒujī bù néng zhàoxiàng.
Zhè zhī shǒujī néng bu néng shàngwǎng?

u14-capability.remember: 能 + action; 不能 + action. 上網 is one new word made from familiar characters.

u14-new-phone.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng mǎi yì zhī xīn shǒujī.
u14-new-phone.meaning: I would like to buy a new phone.

u14-which-kind.pinyin: Nǐ xiǎng mǎi nǎ zhǒng shǒujī?
u14-which-kind.meaning: What kind of phone would you like to buy?

u14-new-or-old.pinyin: Nǐ xǐhuān xīn de háishì jiù de?
u14-new-or-old.meaning: Do you like the new one or the old one?

u14-cheap-one.note: You are choosing between the phones in front of you.

u14-too-expensive.pinyin: Zhè zhī shǒujī tài guì le.

u14-why-not.text: 你為什麼不買那支手機？
u14-why-not.pinyin: Nǐ wèishénme bù mǎi nà zhī shǒujī?
u14-why-not.meaning: Why are you not buying that phone?

u14-can-online.pinyin: Zhè zhī shǒujī néng shàngwǎng ma?

u14-cannot-photos.pinyin: Nà zhī shǒujī bù néng zhàoxiàng.

u14-both-functions.text: 這支手機能照相，也能上網。
u14-both-functions.pinyin: Zhè zhī shǒujī néng zhàoxiàng, yě néng shàngwǎng.
u14-both-functions.meaning: This phone can take photos and can also go online.
